Update your existing participant profile with the latest information.

### Your Task

Edit `participants/yourusername.md` with your updated details.

### Steps

1. Fork this repo & clone your fork
2. Create a branch: `feature/update-your-username`
3. Edit `participants/yourusername.md` with your new info
4. Commit, push, and open a PR

```bash
git checkout -b feature/update-your-username
# edit participants/yourusername.md
git add participants/yourusername.md
git commit -m "docs: update your-username profile"
git push -u origin feature/update-your-username
```

### Review

A team member will review your PR. Once approved, it'll be merged!

Reply to this issue if you get stuck.
